creature.name: Irriseni Owlbear

mid.name: Bloodcurdling Screech
entries: The owlbear unleashes a loud screech that terrifies its prey. Each creature in an 80-foot emanation must attempt a DC 22 Will save. Regardless of the result, creatures are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

mid.name: Critical Failure
entries: The creature is fleeing for 1 round and frightened 3.

mid.name: Gnaw
entries: The owlbear attempts to disembowel the creature with a beak Strike. If the Strike hits, the target must attempt a DC 24 Will save.

mid.name: Failure
entries: The target is sickened 1 and slowed 1 as long as it remains sickened.

mid.name: Screeching Advance
entries: The owlbear makes a Bloodcurdling Screech and Strides twice. All creatures within 80 feet of the owlbear at any point during this movement are subjected to the effects of Bloodcurdling Screech.

_aon.markdown:
A cultural symbol for Irrisen, the Irriseni owlbear is particularly well adapted to frosty conditions. These owlbears are larger than their temperate zone counterparts. **[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 20 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 18 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 15 [Irriseni Owlbear](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2075) **Source** [Travel Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=141) pg. 99 **Perception** +15; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=23), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=33) (imprecise) 30 feet **Languages** **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +9, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +16, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +12 **Str** +6 **Dex** +1 **Con** +5 **Int** -4 **Wis** +3 **Cha** +0 --- **AC** 23 **Fort** +15 **Ref** +9 **Will** +13 **HP** 85 **Resistances** [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27) 5 --- **Speed** 25 feet **Melee** talon +16 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)), **Damage** 1d10+8 piercing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=18) **Melee** beak +16, **Damage** 1d12+8 piercing **Bloodcurdling Screech** ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [Fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) The owlbear unleashes a loud screech that terrifies its prey. Each creature in an 80-foot emanation must attempt a DC 22 Will save. Regardless of the result, creatures are temporarily immune for 1 minute.
**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19).
**Failure** The creature is frightened 2.
**Critical Failure** The creature is [fleeing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=17) for 1 round and frightened 3. **Gnaw** **Requirements** The owlbear has a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20) with its talons. **Effect** The owlbear attempts to disembowel the creature with a beak Strike. If the Strike hits, the target must attempt a DC 24 Will save.
**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target is [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34).
**Failure** The target is sickened 1 and [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35) as long as it remains sickened. **Screeching Advance** ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [Fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) The owlbear makes a Bloodcurdling Screech and Strides twice. All creatures within 80 feet of the owlbear at any point during this movement are subjected to the effects of Bloodcurdling Screech.

creature.name: Whalesteed

mid.name: Aquatic Echolocation
entries: A whalesteed can use its hearing as a precise sense at the listed range, but only underwater.

mid.name: Deep Breath
entries: A whalesteed can hold its breath for 2 hours.

mid.name: Ramming Speed
entries: The whalesteed Swims twice and then makes a snout Strike. As long as it moved at least 20 feet, it gains a +1 circumstance bonus to its attack roll. A Large or smaller creature hit by this attack must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude save or be slowed 1 for 1 round.

_aon.markdown:
Whalesteeds were first tamed in the Shackles as part of an ambush between rival pirate captains. Whalesteed riders are still an unusual sight, as learning to master the skill takes years of training. **[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 14 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 12 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 9 [Whalesteed](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2077) **Source** [Travel Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=141) pg. 99 **Perception** +7; aquatic echolocation 120 feet, [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=23) **Languages** **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +6 **Str** +2 **Dex** +3 **Con** +2 **Int** -4 **Wis** +3 **Cha** +0 **Aquatic Echolocation** A whalesteed can use its hearing as a precise sense at the listed range, but only underwater.
**Deep Breath** A whalesteed can hold its breath for 2 hours. --- **AC** 15 **Fort** +6 **Ref** +7 **Will** +5 **HP** 16 --- **Speed** swim 60 feet **Melee** snout +6, **Damage** 1d6+2 bludgeoning **Melee** jaws +6, **Damage** 1d6+2 piercing **Ramming Speed** The whalesteed Swims twice and then makes a snout Strike.
